evidence_source: user-reported hw002_timing.py benchmark outputs in both directions
scope: same-bench 42-byte timing series with fixed PHY and 1% experimental pacing
causal_next_step: A/B the responder loop cadence while keeping PHY, H2 wire format, frame size, pacing, placement and timing instrumentation fixed: baseline loop delay 1 ms versus a no-1-ms-sleep variant.
interpretation: Across both physical responder boards, almost all observed sub-millisecond RTT variation co-varies approximately one-for-one with responder RX-done IRQ to handleReceivedPacket latency. This localizes the phenomenon to responder scheduling/loop latency, but does not by itself prove delay(1) is the sole cause.
scientific_boundary: All correlations are descriptive for two sequential same-bench fixed-PHY runs. Samples are not independent, the cross-clock residual is not propagation delay, and no range or deployment loss claims are supported.
